items.title_en: US mortgage rates end the week at 7.12% as the 10-year yield approaches 5%
items.title_zh: 美国抵押贷款利率收于 7.12%，10 年期美债收益率逼近 5%
items.summary_en: The 30-year mortgage rate ended the week at 7.12%, its first move above 7% this year, after an escalation of the Iran conflict pushed the 10-year Treasury yield closer to 5%. Rates had been as low as 5.99% at one point in 2026. Mortgage spreads narrowed slightly to 1.92% from 1.94% the week before, against a historical range of 1.60% to 1.80%; at the widest spread levels of 2023 the same 10-year yield would imply a mortgage rate of 8.31%.
items.summary_zh: 美国 30 年期抵押贷款利率上周收于 7.12%，为今年首次升破 7%。此前伊朗冲突升级推动 10 年期美债收益率进一步逼近 5%。该利率在 2026 年内一度低至 5.99%。抵押贷款利差小幅收窄至 1.92%，前一周为 1.94%，历史区间为 1.60% 至 1.80%；若按 2023 年最阔的利差水平计算，当前 10 年期收益率对应的抵押贷款利率将达 8.31%。

items.title_en: KKR and Neuberger Berman anchor a debt recapitalisation at Datavant
items.title_zh: KKR 与 Neuberger Berman 主导 Datavant 债务重组融资
items.summary_en: KKR and Neuberger Berman are anchoring a debt recapitalisation of Datavant, according to Axios. Terms were not reported.
items.summary_zh: 据 Axios 报道，KKR 与 Neuberger Berman 将主导 Datavant 的债务重组融资。报道未披露交易条款。
